title: Intelligence Service + API + Slice (F-004 Core)
description: Build the writing intelligence backend: analysis orchestration service, intelligence API module, Zustand slice, and filesystem caching layer. The service orchestrates chapter-by-chapter analysis via existing gateway agent endpoints (agentGetContext), caches results with content_hash invalidation.
action: Create src/services/intelligenceService.ts with orchestration logic (chapter-by-chapter analysis via gateway, content_hash caching in Tauri appDataDir). Create src/api/intelligence.ts with analysis API functions. Create src/stores/app/intelligenceSlice.ts with analysis state (results, loading, progress). Add types for AnalysisModule, AnalysisResult, CharacterArcData, PacingData, ConsistencyData, ReadabilityData.

criteria: src/services/intelligenceService.ts exists and exports analyzeProject, getCachedAnalysis, invalidateAnalysis functions
src/api/intelligence.ts exists and exports callAnalysisAgent function
src/stores/app/intelligenceSlice.ts exists and exports createIntelligenceSlice and IntelligenceSlice type
src/stores/app/appStore.ts contains createIntelligenceSlice and IntelligenceSlice in AppState type
intelligenceService.ts contains hashContent or imports hashContent from projectFileService
intelligenceSlice.ts contains state fields: analysisResults, isAnalyzing, analysisProgress, analysisError
convergence.verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit and verify no type errors in new files. Grep for all exported functions and verify they exist.
convergence.definition_of_done: Intelligence service can orchestrate multi-chapter analysis, cache results per chapter with content_hash, and Zustand slice exposes analysis state to the app

files.change: New file: orchestrate chapter-by-chapter analysis via gateway agent, cache results to Tauri filesystem with content_hash, provide getCachedAnalysis and invalidateAnalysis
New file: callAnalysisAgent function that sends analysis prompt to gateway agentGetContext endpoint with module-specific prompt templates
New file: Zustand slice with analysisResults (per module), isAnalyzing, analysisProgress (chapters processed/total), analysisError, startAnalysis, clearAnalysis actions
Import and spread createIntelligenceSlice, add IntelligenceSlice to AppState union type
Add AnalysisModule type ('character_arc'|'pacing'|'consistency'|'readability'), AnalysisResult, AnalysisCache types

implementation: 1. Add types to src/types/project.ts: AnalysisModule = 'character_arc'|'pacing'|'consistency'|'readability', AnalysisResult {module, projectId, chaptersAnalyzed, result, createdAt, contentHashes}, AnalysisCacheEntry {module, result, contentHashes, updatedAt}

2. Create src/api/intelligence.ts: callAnalysisAgent(module: AnalysisModule, chapterContent: string, storyBibleContext?: string) that builds module-specific analysis prompt and calls agentGetContext with {scene_info: {content: chapterContent, analysis_type: module}, context_types: ['analysis']}

3. Create src/services/intelligenceService.ts: (a) analyzeProject(projectId, module, chapterIds?, forceRefresh?) — reads all chapter contents via projectFileService, computes content_hash per chapter, checks cache for unchanged chapters, calls callAnalysisAgent for each changed chapter sequentially, aggregates results, writes cache. (b) getCachedAnalysis(projectId, module) — reads from Tauri appDataDir analysis/{projectId}/{module}.json. (c) invalidateAnalysis(projectId) — removes cached results. Cache path: projects/{projectId}/analysis/{module}.json. Use ensureDir + writeTextFile pattern from projectFileService.

4. Create src/stores/app/intelligenceSlice.ts: state = {analysisResults: Record<AnalysisModule, AnalysisResult|null>, isAnalyzing: boolean, analysisProgress: {processed: number, total: number}, analysisError: string|null}. Actions: startAnalysis(projectId, module) — sets isAnalyzing, calls intelligenceService.analyzeProject with progress callback updating analysisProgress, stores result in analysisResults, clears isAnalyzing. clearResults() — resets all state.

5. Modify src/stores/app/appStore.ts: import {createIntelligenceSlice, IntelligenceSlice} from './app/intelligenceSlice', add ...createIntelligenceSlice(...args) to create<AppState>(), add IntelligenceSlice to AppState type union

unit: intelligenceService.analyzeProject with mocked projectFileService and callAnalysisAgent returns aggregated results
intelligenceService uses cached results for unchanged chapters (skips API call)
intelligenceSlice startAnalysis sets isAnalyzing=true then false on completion
intelligenceSlice stores results keyed by AnalysisModule
success_metrics: npx tsc --noEmit has no errors in new files

reference.pattern: projectFileService.ts pattern: Tauri filesystem operations with hashContent caching

rationale.chosen_approach: Frontend-orchestrated analysis via existing gateway avoids sidecar changes. Filesystem caching matches established projectFileService pattern.
decision_factors: No new sidecar endpoints needed (locked decision from analysis)
Content hashing already implemented in projectFileService.ts
Zustand slice pattern consistent with all other slices
rationale.tradeoffs: Frontend orchestration means all chapters processed sequentially (no server-side parallelism), but acceptable for on-demand analysis

risks: LLM context window limits for long chapters — mitigate by truncating to ~4000 chars per analysis call
Analysis prompt engineering quality — start with structured prompts, iterate based on results
